title: Power Echoes: Investigating Moderation Biases in Online Power-Asymmetric Conflicts
reasoning: The paper is an empirical study on human and human-AI moderation biases in online power-asymmetric conflicts. It investigates cognitive and social biases like the 'underdog effect' and 'legitimate power bias' but does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics as specified in the instructions.
